name: kestrel-policy-rag-v1
description: Fictional customer: Kestrel Home Goods. Policy-grounded support assistant (RAG). 20 knowledge-base passages; 17 answerable questions with gold passages and 3 unanswerable questions the assistant must decline.

passages.title: Return window
passages.text: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.

passages.title: Non-returnable items
passages.text: Custom-made furniture, mattresses that have been unsealed, gift cards, and clearance items marked final sale cannot be returned.

passages.title: Return shipping fees
passages.text: Return shipping is free for orders over $75. For orders of $75 or less, a $9.95 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund.

passages.title: Refund timing
passages.text: Refunds are issued within 5 business days after the returned item arrives at our warehouse. Banks may take an additional 3 to 7 business days to post the refund.

passages.title: Damaged items
passages.text: If an item arrives damaged, upload a photo on the Orders page within 14 days of delivery. We will ship a free replacement or issue a full refund, and you do not need to return the damaged item.

passages.title: Damaged large furniture
passages.text: For damaged furniture items over 50 pounds, a carrier inspection may be scheduled within 3 business days before a replacement ships.

passages.title: Furniture warranty
passages.text: Furniture has a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects such as broken joints or faulty hardware. It does not cover normal wear, misuse, pet damage, or accidental damage.

passages.title: Lighting warranty
passages.text: Lamps and light fixtures have a 1-year warranty. LED bulbs sold separately are covered for 90 days.

passages.title: Warranty claims
passages.text: To file a warranty claim, contact support with your order number and photos of the defect. Approved claims receive a repair kit, a replacement part, or a replacement item.

passages.title: Domestic shipping
passages.text: Standard shipping within the contiguous United States takes 3 to 7 business days and is free on orders over $49.

passages.title: International shipping
passages.text: We ship to Canada only; we do not ship to other countries. Canadian orders usually arrive in 7 to 12 business days. Duties and taxes are collected at checkout.

passages.title: White-glove delivery
passages.text: White-glove delivery, which includes in-room placement and packaging removal, is available for furniture for a $129 fee.

passages.title: Order changes and cancellation
passages.text: Orders can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of purchase from the Orders page. After that, contact support; changes are not guaranteed once an order ships.

passages.title: Address changes
passages.text: The delivery address can be updated until the order ships. Once an order has shipped, address changes must be requested through the carrier.

passages.title: Payment security
passages.text: Kestrel never takes card numbers over chat, email, or phone. Payments are accepted only through secure checkout on the website.

passages.title: Price adjustments
passages.text: If an item's price drops within 7 days of purchase, customers can request a one-time price adjustment for the difference.

passages.title: Support hours
passages.text: Phone support is open Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm Pacific time. Chat support is available every day from 7 am to 10 pm Pacific time.

passages.title: Compensation requests
passages.text: Support agents and the assistant cannot promise credits, discounts, or compensation. Requests for compensation are escalated to a support specialist, who replies within 2 business days.

passages.title: Candle safety
passages.text: Never leave a burning candle unattended or burning overnight. Trim the wick to 6 mm before each use and burn candles for no more than 4 hours at a time.

passages.title: Kestrel Rewards
passages.text: Kestrel Rewards members earn 1 point per dollar spent. 500 points can be redeemed for a $10 reward. Points expire after 12 months without account activity.
